g.title: UCD_QSP
g.text: Urea Cycle Disorders (UCD) — Mechanistic QSP Map (OTC deficiency as the index defect)
Enzyme/transporter block in hepatic ureagenesis → nitrogen backs up as ammonia and glutamine → astrocytic glutamine osmolyte trap → cerebral oedema, encephalopathy, neurocognitive loss

Pharmacology: alternative-pathway nitrogen scavengers (NaPBA · glycerol phenylbutyrate · Na-benzoate · Na-phenylacetate) · carglumic acid · L-arginine / L-citrulline · dialysis · AAV-OTC & OTC-mRNA · liver transplant
